These operators define a dualistic system: one layer (Layer 1) aggregates static and dynamic market data, while the other (Layer 2) applies reasoning to derive situational intelligence. The failure mode arises when temporal drift in line history undermines the validity of historical baselines, or when cross-platform inconsistencies in line warehouse distort signal weights. Conformal calibration in GSI ensures robustness against such noise, while GSE’s reasoning engine relies on telemetry-driven premise dossiers to maintain coherence in high-dimensional state transitions.
